_source: community-documented shape, not a captured response. No agent has the owner's JPDB_API_KEY, so every value below is hand-written to the shape the community documents; the vids/sids and frequency ranks are plausible placeholders, while the spellings, readings and furigana splits are real (they follow the JmdictFurigana convention). The request this stands in for: POST https://jpdb.io/api/v1/parse with body {"text": ["日本語を話す。お茶と食べ物をたべる。"], "token_fields": ["vocabulary_index", "furigana"], "vocabulary_fields": ["vid", "sid", "spelling", "reading", "pitch_accent", "frequency_rank", "part_of_speech"]}. IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN M2.1F: capture exactly that (same sentence, same fields), replace the "response" value with what comes back, and delete this key — tests read only "response", so nothing else changes. The five words are the furigana_to_anki golden cases (leading kanji, kanji after kana, all kana, two adjacent kanji groups, kanji-kana-kanji); keep them in the sentence or the golden tests lose their subject.
